title: Network diagnostics
desc: Ping, traceroute, port probe, DNS lookup, speed test and LAN scan
dnsServerPlaceholder: Leave empty for the system resolver; e.g. 223.5.5.5 or https://dns.alidns.com/dns-query
downloadUrlPlaceholder: Empty uses Cloudflare; pick a node or enter a URL
scanHelp: Only private subnets are scanned (up to 1024 addresses). Hosts are detected as online via TCP probes; MAC addresses come from the system neighbor table.
denyHelp: Cloud metadata addresses (such as 169.254.169.254) are always blocked. You can add more IPs or subnets that diagnostic tools must not access, one per line.
